Definition: properly, antique, i.e. venerable or splendid
BiblicalUsage: Isaiah says the merchandise of Tyre will be holiness to the LORD, and it will not be treasured up or laid by, but given to those who dwell before Him. The word means antique or venerable, something kept for its value.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that wealth kept for God stops being a treasure hoarded and becomes a provision for His people.
